title: Client marketing launch
context: The client approved the visual direction. Complete the conversion site, handle a scope change, launch, and hand off ownership.

stories.title: Publish configurable services and service areas
stories.outcome: Visitors can verify that ClearPath provides the needed service in their location.
stories.context: The owner must be able to add an approved service or suburb through one configuration source.
acceptanceCriteria: Service and service-area pages derive from typed configuration
Unknown slugs produce a real not-found response
Every page has accurate unique title, description, canonical, and useful internal links
stories.dataContract: Service has slug, name, summary, body, featured flag; location has slug, name, region, summary.

expectations.security: Configured content is trusted repository content only.
expectations.accessibility: Logical headings and descriptive link text.
expectations.analytics: Page views may use route only, not personal data.

definitionOfDone: Adding one fixture generates the expected page and sitemap entry

stories.title: Deliver validated quote requests
stories.outcome: A qualified visitor can request a quote and understands success or failure.
stories.context: Collect only name, contact method/value, service, suburb, and a short description. Email is delivered through Resend from server code.
acceptanceCriteria: Client and server validation provide specific accessible errors
Server response distinguishes validation, provider, configuration, and success outcomes without exposing internals
Form prevents duplicate submits while pending and preserves safe input on retry
A missing provider key produces a documented non-production fallback without claiming delivery
stories.dataContract: Quote request: name, contactPreference, contactValue, service, suburb, description, consent; normalize and limit lengths.

expectations.security: Validate server-side, rate-limit reasonably, keep provider key server-only.
expectations.privacy: Collect minimum data; never log full request or send it to analytics.
expectations.accessibility: Labels, error summary, focus management, status announcement.
expectations.analytics: Record quote_success or quote_failure category without field values.

stories.title: Assess online appointment scheduling request
stories.outcome: The client receives a professional scope recommendation before implementation.
stories.context: Dana asks, 'Can we quickly let people book any open slot on our calendar before launch?' This introduces workflow and integration decisions not in the signed scope.
acceptanceCriteria: Response identifies unanswered business, calendar, cancellation, privacy, design, testing, and support questions
At least two approaches and a defer option are compared
Recommendation states cost, schedule impact, risk, and next approval

expectations.security: Consider calendar permissions and webhook authenticity.
expectations.accessibility: Any vendor embed must be evaluated.
expectations.analytics: Define booking success only if approved.

definitionOfDone: Change response is approved or deferred explicitly

stories.title: Complete launch and client handoff
stories.outcome: The site is production-ready and the client can operate the agreed content.
stories.context: Run content, responsive, accessibility, SEO, privacy, form, environment, and rollback checks before promoting production.
acceptanceCriteria: Production domain and core journeys are verified after deployment
Sitemap, robots, metadata, and structured data use accurate fictional business facts
Handoff identifies content source, environment ownership, image replacements, analytics, rollback, and support boundary
Mentor review reaches at least 3 of 4 in every category with no critical security failure

expectations.security: Production configuration reviewed; no secret in client bundle or repository.
expectations.analytics: CTA events verified with synthetic actions.

definitionOfDone: Production and handoff evidence are complete
